name: ibis Balikpapan
short_description: A 155-room budget hotel in central Balikpapan sharing an address with Novotel Balikpapan, about 20 minutes from the airport.
ai_summary: ibis Balikpapan is a 155-room budget-tier property sharing a complex with the neighboring Novotel Balikpapan on Jalan Brigjen Ery Suparjan, in the heart of Balikpapan's city centre. Rooms come with flat-screen TVs, air conditioning, and en-suite bathrooms with separate shower and toilet, aimed at business and leisure travelers who want ibis's straightforward budget standard rather than a full-service stay. Guest reviews are consistently positive for a budget property, repeatedly praising the central location, fast check-in, and breakfast, with the hotel ranked among the higher-rated options in Balikpapan on TripAdvisor. It sits roughly 20 minutes from Sultan Aji Muhammad Sulaiman Sepinggan International Airport and within walking distance of the same shopping and dining cluster that serves its sister Novotel property.

faqs.question: Is ibis Balikpapan connected to Novotel Balikpapan?
faqs.answer: They share the same address and complex on Jalan Brigjen Ery Suparjan in central Balikpapan, with ibis offering a simpler, budget-tier version of the stay alongside the more full-service Novotel property, though each operates as its own distinct hotel with separate check-in.

faqs.question: How far is ibis Balikpapan from the airport?
faqs.answer: About 20 minutes by car from Sultan Aji Muhammad Sulaiman Sepinggan International Airport, in the same central Klandasan location as its sister Novotel property, making it a convenient budget base for both business travelers and short leisure stays in Balikpapan.
